state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the mileage rate for a business trip in a private electric car today? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q3: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What monthly mobile allowance applied to a regular employee using a private phone on 2026-01-15? (answer in EUR per month)
- Q5: What is the purchase approval threshold for a regular department's purchase from a supplier with a framework contract today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the daily meal allowance that applies to: What is the daily meal allowance for a standard travel day today (2026-10-13)?

passages.source: HB-06 §2 | Policy FAQ — Current daily meal allowance | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard daily meal allowance? A: 51 EUR per day, as set in HB-08 §2 (effective 2026-05-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-02.

passages.source: HB-02 §1 | Memo: daily meal allowance exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-08-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the daily meal allowance in HB-08. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner.

passages.source: HB-08 §2 | Travel policy: meals — Standard daily meal allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-17
passages.text: The daily meal allowance during business travel is 51 EUR per day. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section.

passages.source: HB-17 §2 | Travel policy: meals — Standard daily meal allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-08-01 to the day before 2026-05-01 · superseded by: HB-08
passages.text: The daily meal allowance during business travel was 59 EUR per day. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment.

passages.source: HB-02 §3 | Memo: daily meal allowance exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-08-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to interns; they follow the standard daily meal allowance in HB-08 §2. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment.
